news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.19 (vs ₹4.11 loss in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.19 (up from ₹4.11 loss in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹210.2m (up ₹200.4m from FY 2025). Net income: ₹2.68m (up ₹67.1m from FY 2025). Profit margin: 1.3% (up from net loss in FY 2025). The move to profitability was driven by higher revenue. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 58% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 336% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
